programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: In 1928, an earthquake shift uncovers a row of painted warriors -- seven-foot statues encasing mummies from an ancient civilization; curious bone arrangements in Winterborne are somehow linked to intermingled ashes from dig sites of Slovenia.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: The ghost hunters trek to Calgary's historic Inglewood neighborhood and the Alexandra Centre, a sturdy three-story sandstone building with a highly haunted history; they're given a tour and tips by another ghost hunter.

programs.title: Revolutions That Changed History
programs.desc: A secret society of Russian military officers with dreams of political revolution set out to overthrow the Romanovs by spreading a lie about one Tsar usurping another.

programs.title: Nintendo 64 Quest
programs.desc: Jay makes an unexpected visit to Good Time Games in Waterloo and cannot believe what he finds.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Young adults accompany their parents back to their country of origin, where they relive the sacrifice, struggle and dramatic circumstances that led to their parents' emigration.

programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: A German village is shocked when a body is found mutilated beyond recognition; when archaeologists investigate further, they find evidence of human sacrifice.
